svg.title: Smart Warehouse Planner — Itinerary: all features
svg.desc: Concept 10 Coupon Book features menu: the wallet opened flat as an itinerary. Every feature is a leg from one screen to the next in flow order, with used, current, next and remaining legs; ground services always open; stage 2 legs marked STANDBY.
svg.text: created by Justas · last edited by Justas
Every feature of Spring re-slot 2026 as a leg, in flow order. Used legs stay listed; nothing is torn out of the wallet.
Milestones 1–2 · each leg opens the next
Name the plan; upload Locations, Inventory and
Transactions, or reuse an existing plan's import
Lists with search and manual move; 214 pick
Mark a whole aisle, a level or a single location;
Run a round; apply, apply with another location
or keep in place · round 1: 5 open
Per aisle: parts in and out, fast-moving in best
locations, pick groups in the same aisle
Print view in round order: from-location first,
a tick box on every line, black and white
Not part of the order; reachable from every leg
Latest move first; reset asks first
Boards after the milestone 2 gate; shown so the plan is complete
Accounts, log in and out, warning on two editors
All aisles, occupancy, tooltips, round route map
Keyword rules, aisle categories, parts out of place
Print labels with location code and QR code
